definitions.explanation: A place that is far from here; a remote location.
Used adverbially to describe doing something from far away.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I want to go far away.
I can see mountains in the distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遠|とお}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してしまって→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: My child moved far away, so I can't see them very often.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえてくる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear music from far away.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}ると→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}ると→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: It looks small from far away, but it's big up close.

notes:
{遠|とお}く is the noun/adverb form of {遠|とお}い (far).

FORM RELATIONSHIPS:
- {遠|とお}い: far (i-adjective)
- {遠|とお}く: far, distance (noun/adverb)
- {遠|とお}くに: in the distance
- {遠|とお}くから: from far away
- {遠|とお}くへ: to a far place

SIMILAR PATTERN WITH OTHER ADJECTIVES:
- {近|ちか}い → {近|ちか}く: nearby
- {高|たか}い → {高|たか}く: high (adverb)

OPPOSITE: {近|ちか}く (nearby)
